notes: Separate from gpt-oss-120b.json: different checkpoint (Quark W4A8 vs native mxfp4), TP=1 rather than TP=4, and a short cached workload rather than W1/W2. Not comparable to those arms.
Optimal config only. The two changes that carry it are the prefill CUDA graph and the fused RMSNorm+MoE-pad unlocked for Quark (the fix committed alongside this data).

The prefill graph is a low-concurrency optimization: it collapses the per-forward kernel-launch floor, which sets TTFT only while the GPU is idle waiting on the CPU. Measured against the same config in eager mode it is -41.5% at cc=1 and -34.5% at cc=2, but +2.6%/+6.9%/+0.4% at cc=4/8/16 where TTFT is already kernel-bound. Enable it for latency-sensitive low-concurrency serving; leave it off when running the engine saturated.
Measurement windows are short (4.2-7.1 s per point at 200 prompts). Treat single-point deltas under ~5% as noise.
